catalogue.selectionDescription: Identify an existing nonrecurring Revaluation batch. Subject TEMPLATE|BATCH or SystemId takes precedence; otherwise use one SystemId alias or templateName/batchName. A SystemId alias precedes the name pair.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Revaluation.PreviewPost
catalogue.description: Forskoðar innbyggða endurmatsbókun og skilar færslum án þess að varðveita þær.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Auðkenndu fyrirliggjandi endurmatskeyrslu sem er ekki ítrekunarbók. subject TEMPLATE|BATCH eða SystemId hefur forgang; annars skal nota eitt SystemId auðkenni eða templateName/batchName. SystemId auðkenni hefur forgang yfir nafnaparið.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Tracking.Assign
catalogue.description: Creates a tracking specification record with a lot, serial or package number and a quantity for an item.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Creates one tracking specification from itemNo, quantity and a lot, serial or package number; it is not tied to a document line.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Tracking.Assign
catalogue.description: Stofnar rakningarforskrift með lotu-, rað- eða pakkanúmeri og magni fyrir vöru.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Stofnar eina rakningarforskrift út frá itemNo, quantity og lotu-, rað- eða pakkanúmeri; hún er ekki tengd skjalalínu.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Tracking.Delete
catalogue.description: Deletes a tracking specification record by its entry number.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Deletes one tracking specification by entry number.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Tracking.Delete
catalogue.description: Eyðir rakningarforskrift eftir færslunúmeri hennar.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Eyðir einni rekjanleikaforskrift eftir færslunúmeri.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Tracking.Get
catalogue.description: Reads lot, serial and package tracking for an item or document line.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Select a source or legacy document line; otherwise select an item. A sales, purchase or transfer line SystemId in subject selects that source.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Tracking.Get
catalogue.description: Les lotu-, raðnúmera- og pakkarakningu fyrir vöru eða skjalalínu.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Veldu uppruna eða eldri skjalalínuvalkost; annars skaltu velja vöru. SystemId sölu-, innkaupa- eða flutningslínu í subject velur þann uppruna.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TrackingAvailability.Get
catalogue.description: Reads tracked inventory, reserved quantities and availability by location and variant.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Select an item using subject or item identifiers; intersect location, variant and exact tracking filters.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TrackingAvailability.Get
catalogue.description: Les raktar birgðir, frátekið magn og tiltækt magn eftir birgðageymslu og afbrigði.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Veldu vöru með subject eða vöruauðkennum; sameinaðu síur fyrir birgðageymslu, afbrigði og nákvæma rakningu.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Transfer.UndoReceipt
catalogue.description: Undoes a posted transfer receipt by writing corrective item ledger entries.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Undoes a posted transfer receipt. Does not delete the posted document.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Transfer.UndoReceipt
catalogue.description: Afturkallar bókaða millifærslumóttöku með leiðréttingarfærslum í vörufærslum.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Afturkallar bókaða millifærslumóttöku. Eyðir ekki bókaða skjalinu.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Transfer.UndoShipment
catalogue.description: Undoes a posted transfer shipment with corrective entries.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Same action as Undo Shipment on a posted transfer shipment.

catalogue.name: Inventory.Transfer.UndoShipment
catalogue.description: Afturkallar bókaða millifærsluafhendingu með leiðréttingarfærslum.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Sama aðgerð og Afturkalla afhendingu á bókaðri millifærsluafhendingu.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Create
catalogue.description: Creates a new transfer order with from/to locations, dates, optional Direct Transfer and optional lines.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Creates a new transfer order header and optional lines; use TransferOrder.Release or Post after creation.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Create
catalogue.description: Býr til nýja millifærslupöntun með uppruna- og móttökubirgðageymslum, dagsetningum, valkvæðri beinni millifærslu og valkvæðum línum.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Býr til nýja millifærslupöntun og valkvæðar línur; notaðu TransferOrder.Release eða Post eftir stofnun.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Post
catalogue.description: Posts a transfer order (ship/receive, or ship+receive for direct transfers).
catalogue.selectionDescription: Posts a transfer order by shipping or receiving it; use PreviewPost to inspect predicted entries first.
keywords: goods arrived at the other warehouse

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Post
catalogue.description: Bókar millifærslupöntun (afhendingu eða móttöku, eða hvort tveggja við beina millifærslu).
catalogue.selectionDescription: Bókar millifærslupöntun með afhendingu eða móttöku; notaðu PreviewPost til að skoða væntanlegar færslur fyrst.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.PreviewPost
catalogue.description: Simulates posting a transfer order and returns predicted ledger entries (Item, Value, G/L) without committing changes.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Previews transfer posting without committing; use Post to perform the irreversible shipment or receipt.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.PreviewPost
catalogue.description: Hermir bókun millifærslupöntunar og skilar væntanlegum vöru-, virðis- og fjárhagsfærslum án þess að vista breytingar.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Forskoðar bókun millifærslu án frágangs; notaðu Post til að framkvæma óafturkræfa afhendingu eða móttöku.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Release
catalogue.description: Releases a transfer order, changing its status from Open to Released.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Releases an open transfer order so it can be posted; use Reopen to edit a released order.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Release
catalogue.description: Staðfestir millifærslupöntun og breytir stöðu hennar úr Opin í Staðfest.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Leyfir opna millifærslupöntun svo hægt sé að bóka hana; notaðu Reopen til að breyta leyfðri pöntun.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Reopen
catalogue.description: Reopens a transfer order, changing its status from Released to Open.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Reopens a released transfer order for editing; use Release to prepare it for posting again.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Reopen
catalogue.description: Opnar millifærslupöntun aftur og breytir stöðu hennar úr Staðfest í Opin.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Opnar leyfða millifærslupöntun aftur til breytinga; notaðu Release til að undirbúa hana fyrir bókun á ný.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Statistics
catalogue.description: Returns transfer order statistics: line quantity, parcels, net/gross weight, volume and reservation state.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Reads transfer order quantities, parcels, weights and volume without changing the order; use PreviewPost for posting prediction.

catalogue.name: Inventory.TransferOrder.Statistics
catalogue.description: Skilar tölfræði millifærslupöntunar: magni á línum, pökkum, nettó- og brúttóþyngd, rúmmáli og stöðu frátekningar.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Les magn, pakka, þyngdir og rúmmál millifærslupöntunar án breytinga; notaðu PreviewPost til að spá fyrir um bókun.
